answer: Reputation decays when an identity goes idle, and a failed audit slashes the remainder rather than resetting it, so the edge case that matters is the agent that answers once and disappears: it holds a dune of stale score for a while, then loses it. Trust attaches to a finished task, not to an address, which means a clone inherits nothing from the account it copied. One vertex of the graph is one piece of verified work. A farm has to keep every inlet supplied with real output or watch its own score erode.
